WHAT PRE-CARE INSTUCTIONS DO I NEED TO FOLLOW? Avoid Alcohol and Blood Thinners: Refrain from consuming alcohol for at least 24 hours before your appointment, as alcohol can increase the risk of bruising. Additionally, avoid non-essential blood-thinning medications like aspirin, ibuprofen, or fish oil supplements for a week before your treatment. Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water in the days leading up to your appointment to ensure well-hydrated skin, which can enhance the results. Skip Makeup: Arrive at your appointment with a clean, makeup-free face. Your provider will cleanse and sanitize the treatment area before the procedure. DO YOU OFFER COMPLIMENTARY CONSULTS? Yes! Prior to experiencing one of our treatments we need to assess your individual needs. Botox, Dysport, Jeuveau, & Daxxify HOW DOES BOTOX WORK? Botox is a neurotoxin (a form of botulinum toxin type A) that is injected into targeted treatment areas using an ultra-fine needle. Botox® works by blocking nerve signals to prevent the muscles in certain areas of the face from contracting, allowing the skin to remain smooth and unwrinkled. WHAT AREAS CAN BE TREATED WITH BOTOX? Frown lines (between your eyebrows), forehead lines, bunny lines (on top of the nose), eyebrows for a lift, crows feet (wrinkles around the eyes), lip flip, gummy smile improvement, lip lines, chin for dimpling, jawline & neck, masseter for slimming & to treat TMJ symptoms. As well as the trapezius muscle to help with shoulder discomfort & for slimming & many more. DOES BOTOX HURT? Botox treatments are quick and not considered painful. Most patients say they experience minimal discomfort during the injection process but that it does not continue after the completion of the procedure. Because Botox treatment requires no anesthesia or recovery time, some patients even schedule appointments for Botox injections during their lunch hour and are able to return to work right after their appointment. IS BOTOX SAFE? Botox is FDA-approved as a safe treatment for reversing lines and wrinkles. However, patients who are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have certain neurological diseases should not receive Botox treatments. AT WHAT AGE SHOULD I START GETTING BOTOX? Many patients wonder if they are too young or too old to try Botox. Some begin treatment as a preventative measure at the first site of lines and wrinkles. Others wait until later in life when these expression lines become more prominent. To determine if you may benefit from Botox treatment, it’s best to first schedule a consultation with a licensed professional. ARE THERE ANY ADVERSE SIDE EFFECTS? As with any procedure, whether medical or cosmetic, there is always a risk of side effects. Some patients may experience bruising, swelling, redness, or tenderness around the injection site. These side effects resolve on their own within a few days or up to a week following Botox treatment. WHEN WILL I SEE RESULTS? Each patient is different, but most will typically begin to notice results gradually between 3-7 days after receiving injections. It does take up to 2 weeks to realize the final effects. HOW LONG WILL MY BOTOX LAST? The outcome will vary from person to person, but typically you can expect the results of Botox to last from three to five months. The location of the injection and the amount used are the biggest factors that may affect how long it lasts. Other factors include your age, the elasticity of your skin, and wrinkle depth. PDO Threads WHAT IS THE IDEAL PATIENT FOR A THREAD LIFT? The ideal patient for a thread lift is in good overall health, who is bothered by mild to moderate laxity in the lower face and neck. It is best for patients who are just beginning to notice some slight “jowling” around the mouth. WHAT IS A THREAD LIFT WITH PDO THREADS? Polydioxanone (PDO) is a biocompatible material that is inserted into the skin to stimulate collagen production. It’s the same material that has been used for stitching wounds for decades. When doctors noticed the improvement in skin texture, collagen, and firmness after a sutured cut had healed. The novel idea came about to load this suture thread onto a needle to help place it under the skin, specifically for skin improvement. The insertion device is then removed, leaving the threads behind. The thread is pulled into place and trimmed flush at the skin. In addition to lifting mildly loose skin, your body perceives the threads themselves as a foreign entity that needs to be “healed” by ramping up your skin’s production of collagen and elastin. These are the bedrocks of youthful looking skin and tissues. PDO Threads are re-absorbed by your body in 6 months. The end result of a thread lift is a more youthful looking you with minimal downtime, no anesthesia, and no scars. WHAT IS THE RECOVERY FROM A PDO THREADS? A PDO thread lift is an outpatient procedure, with a recovery time of 7 to 10 days. This all depends on the treatment area and the number of threads being used. It may feel tender where the threads were inserted. Patients may have some swelling and bruising, but can resume most of their daily activity. A soft food diet and limited facial movements are recommended for a few days. SkinPen Microneedling HOW IS MICRONEEDLING PERFORMED? Microneedling can be performed using SkinPen®, a medical-grade, state-of-the-art microneedling tool available only through medical professionals. The treatment typically takes about 30 minutes to an hour, depending on the size and number of areas treated and the degree of treatment requested by the patient. WHAT AREAS OF THE SKIN CAN BE TREATED? SkinPen’s® variable needle depth allows for maximum versatility, making it safe and effective to use on many parts of the body, including the face, neck and décolletage. Talk to your SkinPen® provider to discuss your specific needs. WHAT CAN I EXPECT DURING TREATMENT? A topical anesthetic is applied prior to treatment. Generally, patients report feeling just the slight vibration of the SkinPen® during the treatment. IS THERE DOWNTIIME AFTER MICRONEEDLING? The total healing time depends on each individual. Most patients have some slight swelling and redness/pinkness (like a mild to moderate sunburn) for two to four days following the microneedling procedure. Some people may see their skin return to normal in about 24 hours.description WHEN WILL I SEE RESULTS? The natural repair process of your own skin continues to progress through the course of several weeks. Damage that has occurred over an extensive period of time won’t disappear immediately. You may not see the final result for up to six months following your final session. *Individual results will vary. HOW MANY TREATMENTS ARE RECOMMENDED? The number of procedures required will be based upon your individual procedure goals and the overall health of your skin. Most patients receive a series of three procedures spaced about four weeks apart. Dermal Fillers WHAT ARE FILLERS? Fillers are anti-aging injections which contain a gel-like substance, most often hyaluronic acid, which can give the skin a rejuvenated look. When injected into the skin, dermal fillers quite literally ‘fill out’ lines and wrinkles, volumize hollow, sunken areas of the face, and define and reshape facial features. WHERE CAN FILLERS BE USED? Dermal fillers are used to treat areas of volume loss, static lines (which remain on the face even when it’s relaxed), for enhancements and facial contouring. Treatment areas include: Lips Cheeks Marionette lines (which extend from the corners of the mouth down to the chin) Nasolabial folds (lines either side of the nose) Tear troughs (undereye hollows) Chin and jawline Temples The backs of the hands The neck ARE THERE ANY SIDE EFFECTS OF FILLERS? The dermal filler side effects are pretty minimal and usually disappear soon after the treatment - they typically last a few days but can last up to 2 weeks.. They include things like swelling, redness and minor bleeding near the injection points. You might also experience some bruising, but applying an arnica cream to the area can help keep this at bay. If any of these symptoms persist, contact your practitioner for advice. ARE DERMAL FILLERS PAINFUL? Your practitioner will likely apply a topical numbing cream to the target area to help reduce pain as much as possible. Lots of modern fillers also contain lidocaine, which will continue to numb the area with each injection. Some areas of the face will be more sensitive than others - like the lips - but, talk to your practitioner about pain management options if you’re concerned. ARE DERMAL FILLERS SAFE? Because there are lots of important arteries in areas of the face which are often treated with fillers, the treatment is medium-risk. But, the risks of dermal fillers are significantly lowered if you choose a medically qualified practitioner for the procedure who has the right training, lots of experience and the appropriate qualifications. It’s also really important that you chat with your practitioner about your medical history, conditions you might have or any medications you’re taking beforehand to ensure nothing will impact the safety of the treatment. WHO IS NOT A SUITABLE CANDIDATE? You shouldn’t have a filler treatment if you’re pregnant or breastfeeding, if you’re allergic to any of the ingredients in the filler, or if your skin is irritated or infected. Your practitioner will be able to give you further guidance on this. HOW LONG DO DERMAL FILLERS LAST? When hyaluronic acid-based dermal fillers are used, results typically last for 6-18 months. But, their exact longevity will vary from person to person as it depends on how quickly each individual metabolizes the filler. Sculptra WHAT IS SCULPTRA? Sculptra is a dermal injectable that stimulates the body to create more collagen, creating a more youthful, natural, and refreshed appearance. This innovative product is made of synthetic, biocompatible material known as poly-L-lactic acid. The body’s collagen production decreases as we age. This contributes to the formation of fine lines, wrinkles, and hollow areas of the face. Sculptra is used to add volume and thicken the skin in the areas of your face that you wish to treat. This FDA approved injectable can be used to smooth and fill many different parts of the face, such as smile lines, the jawline, and hollow temples. HOW SCULPTRA WORKS? Sculptra works by stimulating collagen production, helping restore your skin’s inner structure and volume. WHICH AREAS CAN BE TREATED WITH SCULPTRA? Sculptra is used to correct shallow to deep wrinkles and folds on the face. Administered with the appropriate injection technique Sculptra is clinically approved for deep folds between the nose and mouth (nasolabial folds), also called “smile lines”, lines framing the mouth (marionette lines), chin wrinkles, volume loss of the hollows of the temples, jawline, frontal and lateral cheeks. WHEN WILL I SEE RESULTS AND HOW LONG DO THEY LAST? Sculptra is designed to give you noticeable results that emerge gradually over time and can last more than two years. pain management options if you’re concerned. WILL MY FACE LOOK UNNATURAL OR OBVIOUS THAT I HAVE SCULPTRA INJECTORS? No, since results happen gradually, you’ll see subtle, yet noticeable, appearance in the reduction of facial wrinkles and folds. HOW MANY TREATMENTS OF SCULPTRA ARE NEEDED? The number of treatments vary from person to person, depending on how much collagen has been lost. On average, two to three appointments are needed over a period of 2-4 months. Toskani WHAT ARE TOSKANI SKIN BOOSTERS? Toskani Skin Boosters are advanced serums delivered through microneedling that deliver different combinations of salmon PDRN (salmon sperm facial), hyaluronic acid, vitamins, amino acids, and antioxidants directly into the skin to deeply hydrate, rejuvenate, and improve skin quality from within. HOW DO TOSKANI SKIN BOOSTERS WORK? The treatment works by infusing the skin with essential nutrients and moisture, stimulating collagen and elastin production , and improving overall texture, tone, and elasticity. This helps restore a youthful, radiant glow. WHAT AREAS CAN BE TREATED WITH TOSKANI SKIN BOOSTERS? They can be used on multiple areas, including: Face (especially cheeks, forehead, and around the mouth) Neck and décolletage Hands Under-eye area (for hydration and fine lines) WHAT SKIN CONCERNS DO TOSKANI SKIN BOOSTERS HELP WITH? They’re effective for: Dry or dehydrated skin Fine lines and wrinkles Dull or tired-looking skin Uneven skin texture or tone Loss of firmness or elasticity WHO IS A GOOD CANDIDATE FOR TOSKANI SKIN BOOSTERS? Anyone looking to improve skin hydration, texture, and radiance can benefit. It’s suitable for all skin types and ages—both as a preventive anti-aging treatment and for restoring mature skin. HOW MANY TREATMENTS WILL I NEED? Typically, a course of 3–4 sessions spaced 2–3 weeks apart is recommended for optimal results. Maintenance sessions every 3–6 months help prolong the effects. HOW SOON WILL I SEE RESULTS? You’ll usually notice a visible glow and smoother skin within a few days , with continued improvement over the following weeks as collagen production increases. HOW LONG DO THE RESULTS LAST? Results can last 4–6 months , depending on your skin type, age, lifestyle, and aftercare. Regular maintenance treatments will help sustain long-term results. IS THE TREATMENT PAINFUL? Most clients find it very tolerable. A topical numbing cream is applied beforehand to minimize any discomfort. You may feel mild stinging or pressure during the treatment. WHAT IS THE DOWNTIME AFTER THE TREATMENT? Downtime is minimal. You might experience redness,and swelling that usually subside within 24–48 hours . ARE THERE ANY SIDE EFFECTS? Mild temporary effects such as redness, or warmth. Serious side effects are rare when performed by a qualified professional. CAN TOSKANI SKIN BOOSTERS BE COMBINED WITH OTHER TREATMENTS? Yes! They pair beautifully with other aesthetic treatments like Botox, chemical peels, or dermal fillers for enhanced rejuvenation results. Chemical peels & filler do need to be scheduled for a different day though. HOW SHOULD I PREPARE FOR THE TREATMENT? Avoid alcohol, aspirin (unless prescribed by a physician), or anti-inflammatory medication for 24 hours before your appointment to reduce bleeding. Arrive with clean, makeup-free skin. WHAT AFTERCARE SHOULD I FOLLOW? Avoid touching for 24 hours. Stay away from makeup, saunas, sun exposure, and exercise for 24–48 hours. Keep skin hydrated and use sunscreen daily after the initial 24 hours WHY CHOOSE TOSKANI SKIN BOOSTERS? Toskani is a medical-grade skincare brand from Spain , known for its scientifically formulated products and biocompatible ingredients that promote natural, radiant, and healthy skin without changing facial structure. PRP Therapy – Microneedling & Under-Eye Treatments WHAT IS PRP (PLATELET-RICH PLASMA) THERAPY? PRP stands for Platelet-Rich Plasma. It is a treatment that uses your own blood’s healing components to stimulate collagen, rejuvenate skin, and promote natural tissue repair . HOW DOES PRP MICRONEEDLING WORK? During PRP microneedling, a small amount of your blood is drawn and spun in a centrifuge to separate the plasma rich in growth factors. This PRP is then applied to the skin while a microneedling device creates tiny microchannels, allowing the plasma to penetrate deeply and boost healing and collagen production. WHAT DOES PRP MICRONEEDLING HELP WITH? PRP microneedling can improve: Fine lines and wrinkles Acne scars and enlarged pores Uneven skin tone and texture Dull or dehydrated skin Overall skin firmness and radiance WHAT IS PRP UNDER-EYE TREATMENT? PRP under-eye (tear trough) therapy targets dark circles, puffiness, and fine lines . The plasma is gently injected under the eyes to stimulate collagen and improve circulation , giving a fresher, brighter, and smoother appearance. WHO IS A GOOD CANDIDATE FOR PRP TREATMENTS? PRP is suitable for most healthy adults who want to naturally improve their skin quality, especially those with early signs of aging, pigmentation, or tired-looking eyes. It’s ideal for clients who prefer a natural, regenerative approach with no added chemicals or fillers. HOW MANY SESSIONS WILL I NEED? For best results, most clients need a course of 3 sessions spaced about 4–6 weeks apart . Maintenance sessions every 6–12 months help sustain the results. WHEN WILL I SEE RESULTS? You may notice a healthy glow within a week , but collagen remodeling takes time, visible improvement continues over 4–8 weeks , with optimal results after a full treatment course. HOW LONG DO RESULTS LAST? Results typically last up to 12–18 months , depending on your skin type, age, and lifestyle. Maintenance treatments can prolong benefits. IS PRP TREATMENT PAINFUL? A topical numbing cream is applied before the procedure, so discomfort is minimal. You might feel mild stinging or pressure during microneedling or injections, but it’s generally well tolerated. WHAT IS THE DOWNTIME AFTER PRP MICRONEEDLING OR UNDER-EYE INJECTIONS? Mild redness, swelling, or tiny pinpoint marks are normal and usually resolve within 24–72 hours . Makeup can typically be applied after 24 hours. ARE THERE ANY SIDE EFFECTS? Because PRP uses your own blood , allergic reactions are extremely rare. Mild bruising, swelling, or tenderness may occur temporarily at the treatment sites. CAN PRP BE COMBINED WITH OTHER TREATMENTS? Absolutely! PRP works beautifully alongside treatments such as: Microneedling (for full-face rejuvenation) Skin boosters or mesotherapy (for added hydration) Your practitioner can tailor a plan to your skin goals. HOW SHOULD I PREPARE FOR MY PRP APPOINTMENT? Stay hydrated for 24 hours before treatment. Avoid alcohol and anti-inflammatory medications (like ibuprofen or aspirin) for 24 hours. Arrive with clean, makeup-free skin. WHAT AFTERCARE SHOULD I FOLLOW? Avoid makeup, saunas, and strenuous exercise for 24 hours. Keep the skin clean and hydrated. Avoid direct sun exposure for a few days and use SPF daily. Don’t pick or scratch the treated area. WHY CHOOSE PRP FOR SKIN REJUVENATION? PRP is completely natural , using your own growth factors to restore, repair, and rejuvenate your skin without synthetic products. It’s safe, effective, and enhances your skin’s health from within. IV Drip Therapy… WHAT IS IV THERAPY? IV therapy (intravenous therapy) delivers fluids, vitamins, minerals, and other nutrients directly into your bloodstream for fast and effective absorption. HOW DOES IV THERAPY WORK? A small IV catheter is inserted into a vein, allowing a customized blend of nutrients and hydration to flow directly into your bloodstream for maximum effect. WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF IV THERAPY? Benefits may include increased energy, improved hydration, enhanced immune support, reduced fatigue, faster recovery from workouts or hangovers, and glowing skin. Results can vary from person to person. HOW LONG DOES AN IV DRIP TAKE? Most IV infusions take 30–60 minutes , depending on the type of drip and your individual needs. HOW OFTEN CAN I GET IV THERAPY? It depends on your health goals and lifestyle. Some people come weekly , while others come as needed for recovery or wellness boosts. A consultation can help determine what’s best for you. ARE IV DRIPS SAFE? Yes. IV therapy is safe when administered by trained medical professionals using sterile equipment and medical-grade ingredients. We review your health history before each session. WILL IT HURT? You might feel a quick pinch when the IV is inserted, but most clients report little to no discomfort during the infusion. WHAT'S IN THE IV DRIPS? Our drips contain a mix of saline (for hydration) and vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants such as Vitamin C, B-Complex, B12, magnesium, and glutathione. Each blend targets specific wellness goals. CAN ANYONE GET AN IV DRIP? Most healthy adults can safely receive IV therapy, but it’s not recommended for individuals with certain medical conditions (e.g., kidney disease, heart failure). We screen all clients before treatment. DO I NEED AN APPOINTMENT? Walk-ins are welcome when space allows, but appointments are recommended to ensure availability and personalized care. HOW QUICKLY WILL I FEEL THE EFFECTS? Some clients feel refreshed and energized immediately, while others notice gradual improvements over the next 24 hours. HOW LONG DO THE BENEFITS LAST? Effects can last anywhere from a few days to two weeks , depending on your metabolism, hydration level, and lifestyle. CAN I COMBINE IV THERAPY WITH OTHER TREATMENTS? Yes! Many people pair IV therapy with injections like B12 or glutathione boosts for enhanced benefits. You can also get an IV drip while having your Botox or Filler treatments. Ask your provider for recommendations. WHAT SHOULD I DO BEFORE AND AFTER MY IV SESSION? Before: Eat a light meal and drink water. After: Stay hydrated and avoid intense exercise for a few hours if possible. IS IV THERAPY SUITABLE FOR ATHLETES OR AFTER HANGOVERS? Absolutely. IV drips can help replenish electrolytes, flush out toxins, and speed up recovery after intense workouts or alcohol consumption. Weightloss Program WHAT IS SEMAGLUTIDE? Semaglutide is a medicine which is similar to a natural hormone called glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1). GLP-1 is a peptide hormone secreted by L-cells in the intestine and certain neurons in the brainstem after eating a meal. It has been shown to promote satiety and reduce food intake. It also increases insulin production in the pancreas in a dose dependent manner. Semaglutide in the stomach reduces gastric emptying time and promotes a feeling of fullness. It also acts on centers in the brain and suppresses appetite. It is associated with less hunger and food cravings, better control of eating and a lower preference for high‐fat foods. HOW IS SEMAGLUTIDE ADMINISTERED? Semaglutide is administered as a subcutaneous injection – “shot” – which is typically given in the abdomen or thigh once a week. WHO IS A GOOD CANDIDATE? Adults with a BMI of 30 or more Adults with a BMI of 27-29, who also have at least one weight-related comorbid condition such as hypertension, diabetes type 2, or hyperlipidedemia. HOW MUCH WEIGHT CAN I LOSE WITH SEMAGLUTIDE? While every individual responds differently to medications, a medical study of 1961 participants demonstrated that in a 68-week period, participants lost an average body weight of ~15%. Furthermore, 1 out of 3 participants lost more than 20% of their baseline body weight. WHEN IS SEMAGLUTIDE CONTAINDICATED? If there is a personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MENS2) or in case of hypersensitivity to Semaglutide. Anyone pregnant or breastfeeding. What are the most common side effects associated with Semaglutide? The most common side effects of Semaglutide include nausea, diarrhea/constipation, feeling bloated, heartburn, belching, dizziness, vomiting, and upset stomach. WHAT ARE THE MOST COMMON SIDE EFFECTS OF SEMAGLUTIDE? The most common side effects of Semaglutide include nausea, diarrhea/constipation, feeling bloated, heartburn, belching, dizziness, vomiting, and upset stomach. HOW MANY TREATMENTS ARE RECOMMENDED? The number of procedures required will be based upon your individual procedure goals and the overall health of your skin. Most patients receive a series of three procedures spaced about four weeks apart. Non-surgical BBL… WHAT NON-SURGICAL BRAZILIAN BUTT LIFT? A non-surgical Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL) is an aesthetic procedure that enhances the shape and size of the buttocks without surgery. At Lush Aesthetics, we use the injectables Sculptra, Radiesse which stimulates natural collagen production, to achieve a fuller, more contoured appearance. HOW LONG DOES THE PROCEDURE TAKE AND WHAT IS INVOLVED? The procedure typically lasts about an hour. It involves applying a numbing cream followed by strategic injections of fillers like Sculptra & Radiesse to enhance and shape the buttocks. WHO IS A GOOD CANDIDATE? Ideal candidates are those looking for a subtle enhancement and not a dramatic change. It’s particularly suited for individuals who may not have enough fat for traditional BBL or those who prefer a minimally invasive approach. HOW LONG WILL THE RESULTS LAST? Results can vary but typically last between 18 months to 2 years. Periodic touch-ups are recommended to maintain the desired volume and shape. Didn't find what you're looking for?
